# Publication navigation — mathematical design only

Read the [finite-risk inversion design](README.md), [independent written derivation](independent-review/independent-derivation.md) and [independent review receipt](independent-review/review.json). The derivation establishes a conditional finite-frame coverage statement under its explicit fixed-frame sampling premises. It does not add runtime functionality, a compiled proof, observed risk evidence or a new scientific protocol.

**Implementation remains deferred until G21 has a justified fixed-frame inference target.** G20 source admission remains the priority. This publication creates no new implementation goal, user interface, study allocation, scientific threshold or claim about future materials. All illustrative counts are synthetic hand derivations.

Every original design and review artifact, including the earlier wording and its review, is copied byte for byte. The sole resolved wording issue distinguishes the theorem's mathematical `rho=1` boundary from the existing planner API's strict `0<rho<1` domain. [publication-map.json](publication-map.json) maps historical ignored paths to public copies. Original source bindings refer to their exact checked commit, not a claim that all future copies of the live documentation remain unchanged. There are no byte wrappers, normalizations or hidden content transformations.

The [bound source-document identities](source-bindings.json) refer to public project documentation at commit [a6e87c198d8116d26c523e0e1b2eedce4aeb225b](https://github.com/alexwelcing/lupine/tree/a6e87c198d8116d26c523e0e1b2eedce4aeb225b/discovery). Those mathematical/documentary references are distinct from empirical source data. [Publication checks](publication-checks.json) validate copied bytes and navigation only. The original design and written review performed no runtime test, numerical simulation, Lean build, network request or scientific evaluation. The separate subsequent counting audit below is retained as additive synthetic evidence; it was not rerun while packaging this publication.

The [initial publication-link check failure](publication-first-check-failure.json) is retained: it checked the not-yet-created check-report link. The generation order was repaired; original evidence bytes were unchanged. This was a packaging check, not a product test or scientific failure.

## Additive independent counting evidence

The [independent counting report](counting-review/README.md), [execution receipt](counting-review/execution.json), [review](counting-review/review.json) and [original inventory](counting-review/inventory.json) retain a later, separate exact finite audit. Its first and only invocation exited zero in 6.846437356 seconds with empty stderr. It enumerated 510 binary label worlds through `M=8`, 284 distinct count distributions and 87,380 initial world/subset allocations; 196,776 coverage checks contributed to 707,147 assertions. The optional-stopping example rejected on 16 of 24 permutations. Assertion and allocation counts are bookkeeping for synthetic arithmetic, not independent scientific experiments.

The executed code, recorder, outputs, exact distributions and permutation table are copied without changes in `counting-review/`. Historical ignored paths in the original report and scripts describe the actual recorded invocation; the [reviewed design is here](README.md). This publication does not imply that the original command's ignored layout has been recreated at the public path. No product implementation was imported, no empirical source was read and no Lean theorem was compiled by that audit. Finite exhaustive cases corroborate the written argument within the enumerated range; they do not prove the arbitrary-size theorem or resolve physical/source premises. The original design and its written-review receipts remain byte-identical, and implementation remains deferred.

The [whitespace-check runner correction](publication-whitespace-harness-correction.json) also preserves an initial check-harness error: ordinary `git diff --no-index` new-file status 1 with empty diagnostics was mistaken for a whitespace failure. Final checks accept that ordinary difference status while requiring no whitespace diagnostics; original files were unchanged.
